Shen|sup.identity: Protective tank. Ki Barrier (passive) gives him a shield after every ability (its cooldown drops when he affects champions). Twilight Assault (Q) recalls his spirit blade to empower his attacks (max-health damage, much stronger if the blade hits a champion) and slows enemies moving away from him, Spirit's Refuge (W) blocks attacks against Shen and his allies near the blade, Shadow Dash (E) is a dash that taunts enemies it passes through, and Stand United (R) shields an ally anywhere on the map, then teleports Shen to them.
Shen|sup.playstyle: Global protection support: he taunts enemies with E, blocks attacks with W and saves any ally with his ultimate. He struggles against tank supports and disengage enchanters (Rell, Braum, Janna, Milio), and mostly beats fragile or dive supports (Camille, Yuumi).
Shen|sup.early_game: Trade with Q: bring the blade back through your opponent to empower your attacks. Keep Shadow Dash (E) to engage with your ADC or taunt a diver. Spirit's Refuge (W) blocks the enemy ADC's attacks around the blade.
Shen|sup.level_1: Shadow Dash (E) first. After that, max Q first.
Shen|sup.level_2: Twilight Assault (Q). Combo: E (taunt) → Q (blade through the target) → attacks.
Shen|sup.level_3: Spirit's Refuge (W). Blocks attacks around your blade: place it near your ADC before a trade.
Shen|sup.level_6: Stand United: a shield on an ally in danger anywhere, then a teleport. Save your top laner, join a fight mid or turn an enemy dive into a counterattack.
power_spikes: First resistance items: a durable frontline.
Mid game: 2v2 fights all over the map.
Shen|sup.lane_plan: Engage with E when your ADC can follow, protect them with W. At level 6, watch the map for your ultimate. Stay in the bot lane until level 5: since patch 26.16, your minion gold and XP are cut by a third elsewhere. The support role quest then makes your Control Wards cheaper (40 gold, two stored).
Shen|sup.trading: All-in: E → Q → attacks, W to block the enemy ADC's counterattack. Defense: E on the diver, W near your ADC. Back off against supports who beat you up close (Rell, Braum): play for your ultimate instead.
threats: Rell and Braum, the worst matchups.
Janna, Milio and Seraphine: hard matchups.
Ranged poke that stops you from getting close to taunt.
mistakes: Casting your ultimate too late, on an ally who's already dead.
Using E when your ADC can't follow.
Placing the blade far from your ADC before a fight.

matchup_notes.Thresh: Taunt him with E when he steps up for his hook.
matchup_notes.Lulu: Her polymorph cuts your taunt: engage once she's used it.
matchup_notes.Nautilus: His engage brings him close to you: answer with E.
matchup_notes.Camille: She has to dive: taunt her and block her attacks with W.
matchup_notes.Rell: Her engage outclasses you: protect your ADC and play the map with your ultimate.

Shen|sup.mid_game: Watch the whole map: your ultimate turns every fight from afar. Place Control Wards around objectives.
Shen|sup.late_game: Protect your carry with W, taunt divers with E and save an ally with R. Don't waste your ultimate before the deciding fight.
Shen|sup.ahead: Help every lane with your ultimate.
Shen|sup.behind: Protect your ADC and keep your ultimate to save a carry.
Shen|sup.win_condition: To win this game, you want to protect your team anywhere on the map and win the fights your ultimate joins.
Shen|sup.final_tip: Watch the minimap constantly: your ultimate is only useful if you cast it before your ally dies.
